2609.07879.title: Do Large Language Models Know What They Don't Know II? A Fully Behavioral, Non-Cognitive Measure of Epistemic Honesty
2609.07879.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are frequently confident, eloquent, and well versed. A natural question arises: do they know what they don't know? To answer this question, we borrow the concept of epistemic honesty and develop a novel metric to systematically evaluate whether an LLM appropriately acknowledges the boundaries of its knowledge. In this work, we introduce the Epistemic Honesty Quotient (EHQ), which reports three observable sub-scores across two operational axes (epistemic restraint and substantive-answer calibration), and construct EHQ-3000, a 3,000-question benchmark spanning Fabricated Entity, Post-Cutoff Event, Hyper-Niche True, and Context-Conditioned Questions. From a frozen registry of 21 model API routes, 15 completed the protocol after endpoint and eligibility checks; 14 entered the confirmatory analysis because severe provider-side truncation made one route's score indeterminate. The study reveals substantial variation across models, including a difference that can not be explained by their capability to extract explicitly available information. Composite EHQ ranges from 0.31 to 0.81 across the analysed panel, despite near-ceiling performance on the document-grounded capability probe. The two restraint criteria overlap strongly under the present category composition, whereas substantive-answer calibration varies across models and does not reliably co-vary with restraint; however, the small panel leaves substantial uncertainty. Thus, EHQ reveals behavioral differences that are not visible to conventional correctness-based assessment, while also showing why dataset composition, provider behavior, and confidence elicitation must remain part of the interpretation.
2609.07879.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）通常表現出自信、口才流利且博學的特徵。自然會產生一個問題：它們是否知道自己不知道什麼？為了回答這個問題，我們借用了認識論誠實的概念，並開發了一種新指標，以系統性地評估LLM是否適當地承認其知識的界限。在這項工作中，我們介紹了認識論誠實指數（EHQ），該指數報告了在兩個操作軸（認識約束和實質答案校準）上可觀察的三個子分數，並構建了EHQ-3000，一個涵蓋虛構實體、截止事件後、超小眾真實和上下文條件問題的3,000題基準測試。在一個凍結的21個模型API路徑的註冊表中，15個在端點和資格檢查後完成了協議；由於嚴重的供應商端截斷使得一個路徑的分數無法確定，14個進入了確認性分析。研究顯示模型之間存在顯著差異，包括無法用其提取明確可用信息的能力來解釋的差異。合成EHQ在分析面板中範圍從0.31到0.81，儘管在文檔基礎能力探測中接近上限性能。在當前類別組成下，兩個約束標準強烈重疊，而實質答案校準在模型之間變化，並且不可靠地與約束共同變化；然而，小面板留下了相當大的不確定性。因此，EHQ揭示了傳統基於正確性的評估所看不見的行為差異，同時也顯示了為什麼數據集組成、供應商行為和信心引導必須仍然是解釋的一部分。
